title: Google Listens to Your Videos
transcript: Google listens to your YouTube videos, and most creators have no idea this is happening. This is straight from Google's VP of Search, Liz Reid. She said Google can understand audio and video content at a level we couldn't years ago, meaning they don't just read your transcript, they actually understand what your video is about. So, here's what this means for you. If your video is about how to create pivot tables, you need to actually say, "I'm going to show you how to create pivot tables." Then talk about rows, columns, filters, calculated fields, and actually show these things on screen as you say them. Help the algorithms understand your videos, >> [music] >> and the algorithms will help your videos reach your audience.
